title: Flutter Debug Configuration
description: Configuration for the Flutter debug adapter in Zed

label.description: Human-readable name for this debug configuration

program.description: Path to the main Dart file to run (e.g., 'lib/main.dart')

cwd.description: Working directory for the debug session

args.description: Additional arguments to pass to the Flutter app

env.description: Environment variables for the debug session

vmServiceUri.description: VM Service URI for attach mode (e.g., ws://127.0.0.1:8181/ws)

autoLaunchDevTools.description: Automatically launch DevTools when debugging starts

hotReloadOnSave.description: Trigger hot reload when files are saved
